image.alt: Placeholder art for Orbolo Bridge, an Orbolo path connecting Paraguayan cattle stewardship with global partners

title: Ganadería a Pasto
description: Pasture-based cattle ranching across Paraguay's open land.
longDescription: Ganadería a Pasto follows Paraguay's predominantly flat, low-relief terrain — pasture-based cattle ranching practiced on the ground, not imposed on it.
